以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
On August 16 at Mazda Stadium, Hanshin made the game’s first big move almost at once.

In the first inning, Teruaki Sato hit a two-run home run to center field. Before Hiroshima could settle in, Hanshin had a two-run lead.

But a lead is only the beginning. Hanshin starter Ryohto Ihara gave it room to stand. He worked five innings, allowed two hits and one run, and kept Hiroshima from building a big attack.

Hiroshima’s only run came in the fifth inning, when Elehuris Montero hit a solo home run. It made the gap smaller, but it did not bring Hiroshima level.

Hanshin pulled away again. The Tigers scored in the seventh and added more in the eighth. The early punch became a wider lead, and Hanshin closed out an 8-1 win.

This was not a close escape. Hanshin took charge early, protected its lead, and finished with a clear advantage.

【Point One】
Montero’s fifth-inning home run made the score closer. But Hiroshima never put several runs together, and that remained its only score. The home run was an interruption, not a change in the game’s direction. Hanshin’s lead faced a challenge, but it did not break.

【Point Two】
Sato created the opening, but Hanshin did not depend on him alone. Seishiro Sakamoto drove in runs in the seventh and eighth innings, and pinch-hitter Torai Fushimi added another RBI. Different players kept turning chances into runs.
